title: Angle
description: Guess the size of a random angle in degrees with four tries and hot-or-cold hints, then build your best streak in this free geometry game.
about:
Angle is a quick estimation game for anyone who wants to sharpen their eye for geometry. Each round draws a random angle between 0 and 359 degrees, marked with a red arc, and you enter how wide you think it is. You get four attempts to find the exact number.

After every wrong guess a hint tells you how close you are, from Freezing through Cold and Warm up to Hot and Boiling when you are within five degrees, and your earlier guesses stay on screen as colored chips. Guess right and your streak grows; run out of attempts and the answer is revealed next to your last guess, and your streak starts again from zero. Your best streak is saved.

It is a handy practice tool for students learning to measure angles and a surprisingly addictive challenge for adults who think they can eyeball a right angle.
howToPlay: Look at the angle marked by the red arc and enter your guess in degrees, from 0 to 359, with the on-screen keypad or your keyboard. Press Check or Enter to submit it; you have four attempts per angle and each miss gives a hot-or-cold hint. A correct guess adds one to your streak, then Next angle brings a new one. Skipping an angle resets the streak.

controls.action: Enter your guess and press Check
Check the guess, or go to the next angle

tips: Compare the angle with 90 and 180 degrees first, then refine from there.
Boiling means you are within 5 degrees and Hot within 10, so make small adjustments.
Remember the red arc shows the angle being measured, even when it is wider than 180 degrees.
Hints are based on the plain difference in degrees, so guessing 10 for an angle of 350 counts as very far off.

faq.question: Is Angle free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. It is completely free and runs in your browser with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play it on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. The layout adapts to phones and tablets in both orientations, and you enter your guess with the large on-screen keypad.

faq.question: How does the streak work?
faq.answer: Each angle you guess within four attempts adds one to your streak. Running out of attempts or skipping an angle resets it to zero, while your best streak is remembered.
